# Mise UI

> UI that explains itself. shadcn-registry React components and AI-era states, each with the psychology behind it and an agent skill.

Site: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev
Registry: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/<name>.json (theme first: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/theme.json)
Agent skill: https://github.com/kimjusnu/miseui/tree/main/skills/miseui
Getting started: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/docs

## Blocks

- [Chat Assistant](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/chat-assistant): A full AI chat screen that shows the model working: steps, tool calls, streaming text and a composer that swaps Send for Stop. — Labor illusion. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/chat-assistant.json
- [Dashboard Overview](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/dashboard-overview): A product dashboard built around one number: a large metric with its chart, a quieter row under it, recent activity and the one thing that needs you. All figures shown are sample data. — Visual hierarchy: one number first. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/dashboard-overview.json
- [Empty State](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/empty-state): A first screen that gives people somewhere to start, with one action and three worked examples. — Blank page paralysis. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/empty-state.json
- [Feature Bento](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/feature-bento): An asymmetric feature grid: mixed cell sizes, live visuals built from kit effects in some cells and large type in the others. The features shown are sample content. — Aesthetic-usability effect. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/feature-bento.json
- [Landing Hero](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/landing-hero): A left-aligned marketing hero with one message, two actions and a live product preview built from real components, not a screenshot. The call and the people in it are sample content. — Serial position effect. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/landing-hero.json
- [Login Form](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/login-form): A split login screen with labels that stay visible, inline errors, a password you can reveal and a calm brand panel. — Recognition over recall. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/login-form.json
- [Pricing Table](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/pricing-table): Three plans with one dominant centre, an honest yearly anchor and feature rows you can read straight across. — Default effect and anchoring. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/pricing-table.json
- [Settings Page](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/settings-page): A settings screen in grouped rows, with a save bar that appears only when something changed and a destructive area kept well away from the rest. The person and plan shown are sample data. — Chunking and forgiveness. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/settings-page.json
- [Signup Steps](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/signup-steps): A sign-up that asks one question at a time, starts with real progress on the bar and never ticks consent for anyone. — Goal-gradient effect. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/signup-steps.json

## AI states

- [Reasoning Steps](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/reasoning-steps): Collapsed timeline of the model's steps; the header names the current one, the body shows them all. — Progressive disclosure. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/reasoning-steps.json
- [Streaming Text](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/streaming-text): Reveals arriving text character by character at reading speed, with a caret that marks where the next word lands. — Perceived latency. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/streaming-text.json
- [Thinking Indicator](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/thinking-indicator): Three breathing dots and a live label that tell the user the model is working, and on what. — Visibility of system status · labor illusion. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/thinking-indicator.json
- [Tool Call Card](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/tool-call-card): Collapsible record of one tool call: name, status, duration, and the exact input and output on demand. — Transparency builds trust. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/tool-call-card.json
- [Voice Wave](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/voice-wave): Bars that rise with the microphone level so the user can see they are being heard, and see when they are not. — Visibility of system status. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/voice-wave.json

## Effects

- [Agent Avatar](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/agent-avatar): A deterministic SVG face for an agent: the same seed always draws the same overlapping blobs, in theme colours. — Familiarity · identity. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/agent-avatar.json
- [Beam Border](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/beam-border): One beam of light travelling the border of the surface the model is working on, so the eye knows where to wait. — Selective attention. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/beam-border.json
- [Gooey Morph](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/gooey-morph): Status dots that merge into one body and split apart again like a liquid, so the eye tracks one thing changing. — Object permanence. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/gooey-morph.json
- [Intelligence Glow](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/intelligence-glow): A slow light around the screen edge while the assistant listens or thinks, visible from anywhere on the page. — Global status visibility. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/intelligence-glow.json
- [Liquid Metal](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/liquid-metal): A WebGL metal surface behind a button or chip, with reflections that drift so the control reads as a real, premium material. — Material honesty · premium cue. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/liquid-metal.json
- [Reveal Image](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/reveal-image): An image that arrives as it is generated: blur to sharp, coarse mosaic to fine, or a left-to-right wipe, driven by a progress value. — Perceived progress. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/reveal-image.json
- [Shimmer Text](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/shimmer-text): A band of light passing over a status label, so “Thinking…” reads as in progress without inventing a percentage. — Progress without false precision. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/shimmer-text.json
- [Thinking Orb](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/thinking-orb): A breathing sphere whose motion says idle, listening, thinking or speaking without a word of text. — Ambient status · labor illusion. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/thinking-orb.json
- [Voice Glow](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/voice-glow): A round glow that swells with the microphone level, so the user sees the assistant is listening and how loudly it hears them. — Visibility of system status. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/voice-glow.json

## Transitions

- [Materialize](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/materialize): A surface that arrives like a material coming into focus: slightly smaller, softer, from its anchor, and leaves the same way. — Spatial consistency · materials. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/materialize.json
- [Sheet](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/sheet): Bottom sheet you can grab mid-flight: it tracks the finger 1:1, rubber-bands at the top, and lands where the release velocity was heading. — Interruptibility · momentum projection. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/sheet.json
- [useViewTransition](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/use-view-transition): Five named page-transition presets on the View Transitions API, with a reduced-motion cross-fade and a plain fallback. — Wayfinding · spatial memory. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/use-view-transition.json

## Core

- [Badge](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/badge): Small status chip in five variants; the warm mise variant is reserved for the one item that must stand out. — Von Restorff effect. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/badge.json
- [Button](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/button): Press target that answers on pointer-down: a 3% dip in 100 ms, so the click feels acknowledged. — Doherty threshold. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/button.json
- [Card](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/card): Bordered surface with header, content and footer slots that reads as one region before anyone reads the text. — Law of common region. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/card.json
- [Checkbox](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/checkbox): Square toggle that fills and draws its check within 150 ms of the press, and announces the change through aria-checked. — Immediate feedback. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/checkbox.json
- [Dialog](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/dialog): Modal surface that dims everything else and holds focus until the user answers one question. — Attention funnel. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/dialog.json
- [Dropdown Menu](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/dropdown-menu): Compact menu of actions that opens from a button and closes on choice, with arrow-key navigation and a destructive variant. — Hick's law. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/dropdown-menu.json
- [Input](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/input): Single-line text field, 36 px tall to match Button, that moves the invalid state onto its border and ring. — Fitts's law. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/input.json
- [Label](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/label): Caption bound to a control: clicking it focuses the field, and it dims when the field is disabled. — Law of proximity. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/label.json
- [Popover](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/popover): Small floating panel anchored to the control that opened it, for a form or detail that does not need a full dialog. — Spatial memory. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/popover.json
- [Select](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/select): Dropdown for one choice from a list, with a placeholder, groups, a check on the chosen row and full keyboard support. — Default effect. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/select.json
- [Skeleton](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/skeleton): Pulsing placeholder shaped like the content that is loading, so the wait feels shorter than a spinner. — Perceived performance. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/skeleton.json
- [Switch](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/switch): Sliding on/off control whose thumb travels 16 px in 150 ms, mirroring the physical toggle it imitates. — Affordance. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/switch.json
- [Tabs](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/tabs): Segmented control that swaps one panel for another in place, so related views share a single spot on the screen. — Chunking. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/tabs.json
- [Textarea](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/textarea): Multi-line text field that starts at 64 px and grows with its content, so the answer is never hidden behind a scrollbar. — Chunking. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/textarea.json
- [Tooltip](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/tooltip): One-line hint that appears on hover or focus with no delay and leaves with the pointer, for detail that does not deserve screen space. — Progressive disclosure. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/tooltip.json
